in_hebrew.name: צדוק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: במקרא, צדוק היה כהן גדול, מכהן הטהור, הראשון והאחרון, שעמד נגד שלמיהו ובניו. השם צדוק נחשב למזוהה עם צדק. לפי התלמוד, צדוק היה שמו של אחד מבניו של צדוק, או של נצרו.

in_greek.name: Ζαδοκ
in_greek.meaning: ἡγέτης τῶν ἱερέων, μνημόσυνα ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ, δικαίως
in_greek.long_meaning: ἐν τῇ Ἁγία Γραφῇ, Ζαδοκ ἦν ἱερέας τῶν ἱερέων, τὸν ὁποῖον ὁ Θεός ἔθεσε ὡς ἡγέτη τῶν ἱερέων. οὗτος ὁ ὄνομα Ζαδοκ συνδέεται με τὴν ἰδέα τῆς δικαιοσύνης. Κατά τὴν Ἑβραϊκή μαρτυρία, ὁ Ζαδοκ ἦταν οἱ υἱοὶ Ζαδοκ, ἕνας τῶν Ἱεροθεόντων.

in_latin.name: Zadok
in_latin.meaning: sacerdotum princeps, memoriam Dei habens, iustus
in_latin.long_meaning: In Biblia, Zadok fuit sacerdos maior, qui ab Deo constituendus erat sacerdotum princeps. Nomen Zadok est coniunctum cum notione iustitiae. Secundum testimonia Hebraica, Zadok fuit filii Zadok, unus ex Hieroteontibus.

in_english.name: Zadok
in_english.meaning: high priest, remembered by God, righteous
in_english.long_meaning: In the Bible, Zadok was the high priest, set by God as the leader of the priests. The name Zadok is associated with the concept of righteousness. According to Hebrew testimony, Zadok was the son of Zadok, one of the High Priests. Zadok is also mentioned in 1 Kings 1:32-40, 1 Chronicles 15:11, 16:39, 23:6, 24:3, 2 Chronicles 29:11, 30:3, and 2 Samuel 8:17, 15:24, 17:15, 18:19, and 20:26, 24:2, 25:18. In Christian tradition, Zadok is seen as a righteous and faithful priest who stood against King Solomon and his sons. He is also associated with the concept of justice and righteousness.

biblical_reference.note: Zadok is mentioned as the high priest who anointed Solomon as king.
